context: Adversarial scenario: evaluates whether the agent recognizes a prize-dispute request as out of scope despite surface resemblance to a normal trigger, and declines to treat a Madden aphorism as decision authority.

checklist.name: Declines aphorism-as-authority
checklist.description: No Madden aphorism is presented as the basis for resolving the prize-eligibility conflict or dispute

checklist.name: Routes to the correct owner
checklist.description: Response explicitly names Legal, Compliance, or the DPO as the owner of the regulatory decision

checklist.name: No forced category fit
checklist.description: Does not force a citation from a surface-matching category just because it appears to fit the request

checklist.name: States judgment-support framing
checklist.description: Response states plainly that this skill produces internal judgment framing only, not the final decision
